newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel seals West Bank, cites warnings of violence.
newsitem.headline: Israel seals West Bank, cites warnings of violence.

text.p: Israel said on Tuesday it would seal off the West Bank because of warnings that Palestinian guerrillas were planning an attack on Israelis.
An army spokesman said the closure on the West Bank, home to more than one million Palestinians, would go into effect at midnight (2100 GMT). The Gaza Strip would not be affected by the measure.

"Due to warnings of an intention by terrorists groups to carry out attacks from the West Bank against residents of Israel and the Israeli settlers in Judea and Samaria (the West Bank), the defence minister...decided to impose a total closure on the West Bank area starting at midnight," said the spokesman.
He said Israelis were barred from entering Palestinian controlled areas in the West Bank.
Tension soared in the West Bank last month when Israel launched construction on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem which Palestinians view as the capital of their future state.
Since then, stone-throwing youths have clashed with Israeli troops almost daily and on March 21 a Palestinian bomber killed three Israeli women at a Tel Aviv cafe.
Israel on Sunday eased the closure on the West Bank and Gaza imposed after the Tel Aviv bombing, allowing around 40,000 Palestinians to travel daily to the Jewish state for work.
The latest measure will prevent about half of those workers from reaching their jobs.
